description: Scanning the minimal-claude fixture detects exactly four nodes, one per kind (agent, command, skill, markdown), with no issues. spec 0.18.0 relocated the markdown kind from this Provider to the built-in `core/markdown` Provider: `notes/architecture.md` is disclaimed by claude and picked up by core/markdown's universal fallback classify, so the total count is preserved. Step 9.5 dropped the hook kind (Anthropic does not define `.claude/hooks/*.md` as a node type).
